· Existing same-name lists will be overwritten (repos no longer matching are removed)
· Missing lists will be created (private by default)
· Repos are added to the lists matching their category
· Memberships in lists not managed locally are preserved

settingsUx.selectionHelp: Switch between AGY and API services here. Analysis, discovery and research follow this selection; repository chat can use a separate service below. Switching cancels active AGY requests.
settingsUx.unavailableSelection: The selected service is unavailable. Complete its setup or choose another service. No automatic switching occurs.
settingsUx.batchHelp: Features share the global model, reasoning effort and timeout. Only batch tasks have separate concurrency limits. Effective concurrency cannot exceed the global limit and decreases when rate limited.
settingsUx.apiBatchHelp: Batch analysis concurrency for the current API service. Higher concurrency may be faster but can trigger rate limits and concentrate spending. Changes are saved immediately.
settingsUx.legacyHelp: These older settings still apply. Reset removes model, effort and timeout overrides while keeping batch concurrency limits. Save to apply.
settingsUx.identityHelp: Repair associations between older repository IDs and categories, subscriptions or reading records. Use only for broken historical associations: preview first, then confirm mappings. This does not sign in or resync repositories.
settingsUx.backupScopeIncluded: Only the checked sections below are exported: repositories, releases, organization, discovery cache and reading records, configuration and display preferences as selected.
settingsUx.backupScopeExcluded: Excludes Gists, forks, Workbench chats, daily HTML settings and returned records, mail credentials, independent plugin storage, vector indexes and the backend SQLite database. Back up these stores separately when migrating the whole application.
settingsUx.backupRestoreScope: Import offers a preview before safely restoring repositories, organization and selected preferences. Other fields use a separate compatibility import, which may partially succeed across stores.
settingsUx.localBackupHint: Export a local backup or preview and restore repositories, categories and selected preferences without WebDAV. See Data Management for the full coverage details.
settingsUx.webdavBackupHint: Cloud backup and restore below require WebDAV. Local file backup is available without it.
